Excellent value.
Jan 2019 • Couples
My wife and I visited this place yesterday. It is not very big, and is situated down one of the many alleyways. Blink and you will miss it! It is certainly not a top-notch café/restaurant, but if you want good value for your money, you will be hard-pressed to beat it.
The lady/ owner? who served us was very nice and spoke a little English. My wife had a chicken sandwich with f/fries and salad, while I opted for the beef filet with mustard sauce, which came with a few f/fries and a salad garnish. It was delicious and cooked to perfection. Now, I ask you, where else could you buy such a (approx' 200grams) steak for 97,000vnd?
